shelters.name: Michigan Humane
shelters.description: Changing lives of animals since 1877. Hosts pet-friendly events throughout the year across Metro Detroit.

shelters.name: Michigan Anti-Cruelty Society (MACS)
shelters.description: Make it a be kind to animals world. For many animals, MACS is their only hope.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Huron Valley
shelters.description: Helps more dogs and cats than any shelter in Michigan. Open 7 days a week with no appointment necessary for walk-ins.

shelters.name: Capital Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal welfare organization. Does not receive government funding or tax dollars, not affiliated with other humane societies.

shelters.name: Humane Society of West Michigan
shelters.description: Humane society serving West Michigan and the Grand Rapids area with animal rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Kent County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Provides temporary care and shelter for lost, unwanted, and abused animals. Seeks placement into responsible homes.

shelters.name: Michele's Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit started 1997. No-kill rescue taking in animals from shelters all over the country. Received $20,000 donation from LaFontaine Automotive.

shelters.name: All About Animals Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) dedicated to No More Homeless Pets. High-quality, high-volume spay/neuter and wellness. Locations in Auburn Hills, Detroit, Flint, and Warren.

shelters.name: SPCA of Southwest Michigan
shelters.description: Registered 501(c)(3) not-for-profit. Does not receive government funding. Open Mon-Fri 11am-7pm, Sat 11am-4pm.

shelters.name: Harbor Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the lakeshore communities of West Michigan.

shelters.name: Cherryland Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides care for over 650 animals. Funded by profits from thrift store.

shelters.name: Fig and Friends Pet Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit pet rescue serving the Grand Rapids area.

shelters.name: Friends of Michigan Animals Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Michigan with foster-based rescue programs.

shelters.name: Cascades Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Jackson County and south central Michigan.

shelters.name: Great Lakes Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Dog rescue organization serving the Great Lakes region of Michigan.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Michigan animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Michigan Humane has served since 1877. Humane Society of Huron Valley helps more animals than any other shelter in Michigan. Coverage spans Detroit metro, Grand Rapids, Ann Arbor, Lansing, Kalamazoo, Traverse City, Jackson, and lakeshore communities.
